decisions.reason: The requested wording and layout changes are explicitly directed at the landing-page hero and its displayed prize copy; the FAQ content remains valid unchanged.
The source concerns the top of the landing page and does not direct any change to the separate About page.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing relocation outside the hero, aesthetic sizing, non-overlap, cropping, and removal of the prior hero-integration constraint.
The source changes landing-page presentation and wording, not the separate Mission page; its existing prize description already expresses the retained one-winner-per-100-sales rule.
The source does not remove or alter the live next-draw progress counter or its accuracy requirement.

The source restates the already-current selection rule of one affiliate from each 100-sales block with more referrals providing more chances; it changes only how that rule is worded on the landing page.
The landing-page copy revision does not change ticket issuance, eligibility, expiration, reset, transfer, or weighting behavior.
The source does not change embedded-wallet provisioning, dashboard access, reward custody, or fiat cash-out guidance.
The source does not change automatic prize transfer, payout destination, or winner-notification channels.
The landing-page hero revision does not alter transactional email delivery, contents, or prize-notification behavior.
Changing 'win' to 'giveaway' and removing promotional phrases is a presentation change; the underlying one-$500-winner-every-100-sales mechanism remains unchanged.
The source does not change the Transak provider, supported payment methods, conversion, fulfillment, or deferred lifecycle status.
